patterns: APPSC asks straight 'which Article' items: untouchability = Art. 17, educational/economic interests of SCs/STs = Art. 46.
AP-specific institutional facts appear (AP State Commission for SCs & STs Act 9 of 2003, Safai Karmachari Andolan - Bezwada Wilson).
Other PSCs test Art. 341 (President specifies SCs after consulting Governor), Part XVI scope, 1990 commission's causes of atrocities (religion not listed).

App MCQs go much deeper (sub-classification case law, NCST ranks, 131st Bill, NCRB heads, Andhra Dalit papers) than the one-line PYQs; multi-statement format dominates in the app vs single-fact in APPSC.
Traps: NCST is 338A not 338; no SC/ST seats in Rajya Sabha; relaxed qualifying marks = 82nd Amendment.
